title: Orbit Proposal
body_html:
Summary

Northwind proposal (version 2) to automate the functional verification of the CARESCAPE Central Station. It was won and led to Quartz Programme.

Details

  • Commercial terms: the document contains them, so it stays internal. Do not share it with the client view or prospects.
  • Strategy: hybrid, about 70% manual and 30% selective automation; 24 weeks, fixed scope and milestone-based, in 5 phases, with 90-day hypercare.
  • Scope: about 2,500 to 3,000 scenarios. The solution design counts 329 procedures instead. TODO: confirm the agreed scope.
  • Result: won; the work runs as Quartz Programme.

Source documents

  • Proposal v2 (PDF)
